# Domino

> Enterprise MLOps and AI governance platform for operationalizing, deploying, monitoring, and governing machine learning models at scale.

Domino provides an integrated platform for data science teams to build, deploy, and manage AI/ML workloads with built-in governance, compliance, and risk management capabilities. The platform supports enterprise integrations with cloud providers like AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, and serves regulated industries including life sciences, financial services, government, and manufacturing.

## Key Topics

- MLOps platform
- AI governance
- Model deployment
- Enterprise AI
- Agentic AI
- LLM hosting
- Model monitoring
- Compliance management
- Risk management
- Data science
- Machine learning
- Cloud integration
- Regulated environments
- Model governance
